name: refrigeration_compressor_identification
title: Refrigeration compressor - parameter identification from two operating points
summary: R22 reciprocating refrigeration compressor in a vapour-compression cycle (3 K subcooling, 5 K superheat): four parameters (swept volume flow rate, clearance factor, constant electromechanical losses, loss factor) identified from two measured operating points (cooling capacity and power at two condensing/evaporating temperature pairs, square system) are imposed at their rounded values, and the model predicts the cooling capacity and power at a third operating point (40 C condensing, 2 C evaporating).

authors: Stéphane Bertagnolio (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory, EES solution)
Vincent Lemort (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory, original exercise)
origin.course: ULiège, Machines et systèmes thermiques, repetition 1, exercise 2

verification.reference: EES stored solution of thermo_models TM-0016 (MSTh-SB-R1-Ex2.EES, EES 7.458, full solution of all 86 stored variables)
verification.notes: 77/86 stored variables agree within 0.1 %. The 9 remaining deviations (C 0.85 %, alpha 0.71 %, W_dot_loss_0 0.32 %, M_dot_1/M_dot_2 0.11-0.12 %, v_2_* 0.11 %, epsilon_v_2 0.11 %) all trace to the R22 property formulation (EES 7.4 vs CoolProp); all saturation pressures within 0.04 %, enthalpies within 0.06 %; predictions M_dot_3/W_dot_3/Q_dot_ev_3 within 0.08 %. No unit conversion needed (SI-C-Pa-J).
